The child expressly identifies the February 9 communication and carries forward its distinctive proposal for a comprehensive, multiple-purpose New England–New York land-and-water resources study, Federal and State participation, regional scope, coordinated planning, treatment of particular projects, and a final report. C10 also contributes nearly verbatim language to the child's defense-related qualification, while C19 supplies related commission-study machinery, but neither rivals C22's extensive correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"on February 9, 1950, in a communication to the Vice-President, I endorsed the legislation ... providing for the establishment of a New England-New York Resources Survey Commission and authorizing a full-scale investigation of multiple-purpose resource development with participation by the Federal agencies and the States concerned","parent_excerpt":"I am writing this letter to recommend that the Senate adopt an amendment ... providing for a broadscale study of how the land and water resources of those States may be best conserved and developed ... The amendment would establish a study commission ... including citizens from the region and representatives of the principal Federal agencies concerned.","explanation":"The child expressly invokes C22 and converts its proposed statutory commission and study into an interagency undertaking under existing authority."},{"child_excerpt":"plans for the most effective utilization of water resources must take into account all the multiple-purposes and benefits and also the interrelationships between water and land resources","parent_excerpt":"these problems should be considered together, and met by comprehensive planning and action which recognizes the close inter-relationship of land and water and their manifold uses","explanation":"This is distinctive shared framing of integrated, multiple-purpose land-and-water planning."},{"child_excerpt":"The survey to be conducted by this interagency committee should include the six New England States and New York State.","parent_excerpt":"a broadscale study of how the land and water resources of those States may be best conserved and developed","explanation":"Both directives define the same seven-state regional survey target."},{"child_excerpt":"I am asking the Governors of the seven States concerned to designate official representatives to act as liaison ... the final report carry the concurrence to the Governors for their comments","explanation":"The child closely adapts C22's State-participation and gubernatorial-comment machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"The interrelationship of these projects
